# vastdata_compute_cluster_nodes (Data Source)

Kubernetes nodes in a compute cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_compute_cluster_nodes" "tf_test_cluster_nodes_by_name" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
}

data "vastdata_compute_cluster_nodes" "tf_test_cluster_nodes_by_id" {
  compute_cluster_id = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) Compute cluster ID. Provide this or compute_cluster_name.
- `compute_cluster_name` (String) Compute cluster name. Used to look up the cluster ID when compute_cluster_id is not set.

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) Kubernetes nodes in the compute cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) Node architecture (amd64, arm64, etc.).
- `capacity_cpu` (String) CPU capacity of the node.
- `capacity_memory` (String) Memory capacity of the node.
- `created_at` (String) Node creation timestamp.
- `message` (String) Unhealthy condition messages from the node.
- `name` (String) Node name.
- `os_image` (String) Operating system image.
- `status` (String) Node status (Ready, Unknown).
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version running on the node.
